# Minimal OpenMP offload on 1 tile (from HERO2/apps/omp/basic/offload_benchmark).
# The device code of the 3 regions in src/kernels_omp.c is generated by the HERO
# clang (omp_hero_kernels() in omp/hero_magia.cmake). src/test_offload.c is the
# fake host; main() and the device loop are in the omptarget library.
#
#   make build tiles=1 spatz=0 test=test_omp_offload
#   make run   tiles=1 platform=gvsoc test=test_omp_offload

set(TEST_NAME test_omp_offload)

set(KERNELS_OBJ ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/kernels_omp.o)
omp_hero_kernels(${KERNELS_OBJ}
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/kernels_omp.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/include)

set(HOST_SRC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/test_offload.c)

add_executable(${TEST_NAME} ${HOST_SRC} ${KERNELS_OBJ})

# Workaround for the CORE-V GCC xcvmem ICE: see OMP_ISA in omp/CMakeLists.txt.
set_source_files_properties(${HOST_SRC} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-march=${OMP_ISA}")

target_link_libraries(${TEST_NAME} PUBLIC omptarget runtime)

add_custom_command(
        TARGET ${TEST_NAME}
        POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJDUMP} -dhS -Mmarch=${ISA} $<TARGET_FILE:${TEST_NAME}> > $<TARGET_FILE:${TEST_NAME}>.s)
